property_summary: For any caller and input, once a caller has an active guess (guesses[msg.sender].block != 0) the reference contract never allows that caller to overwrite their active guess via lockInGuess; the mutant (which drops the prior-zero check) can overwrite an existing active guess for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the check that previous guess.block is zero, allowing overwriting an existing guess and changing stored state after call.
